summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the Stock Dashboard follow-up (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/stocks.tsx). All four user-requested changes verified end-to-end on the live Expo web preview at mobile viewport 390x844. (A) Warehouse Utilisation card is now a plain <View> — tapping title, segmented bar and '76% used' does NOT navigate (URL stays /stocks). (B1) Dark 'Reports' header button (bar-chart icon) is visible top-right and navigates to /stocks/reports. (B2) 'Stock Reports' body row with subtitle 'Valuation, ageing & summaries' is present and navigates to /stocks/reports. (C) 'Movement Analytics' body row with subtitle 'Fast & slow moving items' is present and navigates to /stocks/fast-slow (Fast Vs Slow Moving Analysis screen); the Fast-Moving TILE still navigates to /stocks/movement-analytics — confirmed two distinct screens, no redundancy. (D) Neutral palette confirmed: tile icons render on gray background; red retained only on Low-Stock tile and the Reorder Queue alert strip; category bars use single dark color. Regression: Hero->/stocks/total-stock, Warehouses tile ('5 · Active locations')->/stocks/warehouses, Low-Stock->/stocks/reorder-queue, Aged->/stocks/aged-items, Reorder strip->/stocks/reorder-queue, Category 'Report'->/stocks/valuation-summary all PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: stocks.tsx line 174: Warehouse Utilisation is now a plain View (no TouchableOpacity) — correctly removes redundancy with the Warehouses tile.

Two distinct routes intentionally used: Fast-Moving TILE -> /stocks/movement-analytics (line 87), Movement Analytics ROW -> /stocks/fast-slow (line 221). Both target files exist under /app/frontend/app/stocks/.
Reports appears both as a prominent dark header button (line 102-109, brandPrimary bg) and as a body row (line 203-216) — matches the follow-up requirement to make Reports prominent.

Neutral palette applied: STAT_TILES use NEUTRAL (textSecondary) accent with NEUTRAL_BG tint except Low-Stock which retains COLORS.negative for the alert semantic (line 84-89). CategoryBar hard-codes COLORS.brandPrimary (line 244) — single dark color as spec'd.

Non-blocking: When the ScrollView content extends below the fold, the fixed bottom tab bar overlays the last row (Movement Analytics) on shorter viewports until the user scrolls. Test had to programmatically scroll to interact with it. In real use the row is reachable after a small scroll — behavior is standard for RN bottom-tab layouts with paddingBottom:110 already applied on content.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 tap-target checks pass: utilisation non-clickable ×2, reports header, stock reports row, movement analytics row -> fast-slow, fast-moving tile -> movement-analytics, warehouses, low-stock, aged, reorder strip, category report, hero)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth bypass: page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('auth_token','mock_token_123')") BEFORE page.goto. Onboarding shows on every fresh page.goto (module-level session flag in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx line 19); dismiss by clicking text 'Skip'. Reach Stock dashboard by tapping bottom-tab 'Stocks' (use .last selector — 'Stocks' text also exists in the tile grid). Header 'Reports' button has no testID but is uniquely the first 'Reports' text on the page. Movement Analytics row sits below the fold on 390x844 mobile viewport and is initially overlapped by the floating bottom tab bar; use page.mouse.wheel(0, 200) six times to scroll it into an interactable area before clicking. Verified routes: hero->/stocks/total-stock, Warehouses tile->/stocks/warehouses, Low-Stock->/stocks/reorder-queue, Fast-Moving tile->/stocks/movement-analytics, Aged->/stocks/aged-items, Utilisation card->(no nav, stays /stocks), Reorder strip->/stocks/reorder-queue, Stock Reports row & Reports header btn->/stocks/reports, Movement Analytics row->/stocks/fast-slow, Category 'Report'->/stocks/valuation-summary.
